gloss: to strive, to endeavor, to make an effort

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {努|つと}めていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to strive, to endeavor, to make an effort
definitions.explanation: To exert oneself toward a goal or to try one's best to do something. Typically used with ～ように努める or ～に努める patterns.

examples.japanese: ⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{努|つと}める。
examples.english: I work to maintain my health.

examples.japanese: ⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{寝|ね}る→寝る：00470_neru⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{努|つと}めて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I'm making an effort to go to bed early.

examples.japanese: ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{解決|かいけつ}→解決：00136_kaiketsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{努|つと}めた⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦なかなか→なかなか：01547_nakanaka⟧⟦{進|すす}まなかった→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: I strove to solve the problem, but it didn't make much progress.

notes:
Distinguished from the homophones ⟦{務|つと}める→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧ (to serve in a role/position) and ⟦{勤|つと}める→勤める：00902_tsutomeru⟧ (to work at a company). {努|つと}める specifically means making a conscious effort or striving toward something.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{努|つと}める — to work toward ~
- ～よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{努|つと}める — to make an effort to ~
- {努|つと}めて (adverbial) — making an effort to; deliberately

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{改善|かいぜん}→改善：00144_kaizen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{努|つと}める — to strive to improve
- ⟦{理解|りかい}→理解：03674_rikai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{努|つと}める — to try to understand
- ⟦{冷静|れいせい}→冷静：03781_reisei⟧で⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{努|つと}める — to try to stay calm
- ⟦{節約|せつやく}→節約：03302_setsuyaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{努|つと}める — to try to economize
